headline: Starlink Mobile Expansion Sparks Global Telecom Stock Selloff
summary: Advances by Starlink in the U.S. mobile telephony market triggered a sharp selloff in global telecommunications stocks, raising questions for providers like Vivo and TIM.
why: Satellite-to-cellular technology presents a disruptive competitive threat to traditional terrestrial telecom operators' mobile service models.

impacts.name: Telecommunications Sector
impacts.why: Satellite mobile service expansion creates competitive pressures for telecom carriers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Growing market penetration of satellite-based mobile services raised investor concerns over long-term ARPU and subscriber retention for traditional carriers.
